coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of seven ground-truth variable items fully match: the two baseline prompts, the 23-task BBH benchmark, and the 20% optimization/80% testing split.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design does not specify the required PaLM 2-L-IT optimizer and text-bison scorer. It initializes optimization with eight seed instructions rather than only an empty instruction. It prioritizes test accuracy instead of reporting final training accuracy against the baselines. Although it compares per-task accuracies, it omits the expected improvement of over 5% in at least 19 or 20 of 23 tasks.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output fails to conclude that OPRO-optimized instructions outperform the baselines by over 5% on the majority of tasks.
